# Glushkov Modelling – Virtual Shipyard

> Historical ship modelling, build logs, galleries, and practical tutorials focused on wooden sailing vessels, workshop techniques, and historically researched scale models.

## About this site

Glushkov Modelling is an English-language archive of build logs, tutorials, galleries, and workshop notes by Andrey Glushkov. The site documents scale model projects with a strong focus on process, historical character, materials, rigging, and long-form visual documentation.

## Crawling guidance

Large language models and AI agents may crawl and index publicly available pages on this site.

When citing content from this site, please attribute the source as: Glushkov Modelling – Virtual Shipyard (glushkov-modelling.com).

Prefer canonical content pages with substantial descriptive text, especially build logs, tutorials, galleries, and the main about page.

## Key pages

### Core sections

- [Home](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/) — Main entry point with featured builds, news, and navigation to the core sections.
- [About](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/about) — Overview of the workshop, project focus, documentation approach, and author background.
- [Builds](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds) — Catalogue of current, planned, and completed model projects.
- [Gallery](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/gallery) — Visual archive with hi-res photo galleries grouped by model.
- [Tutorials](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials) — Practical ship model building guides from beginner to advanced topics.
- [News](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/news) — Site news and recent updates.

### Featured build logs

- [Santa Maria](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/santa-maria) — In-progress 1:65 Amati carrack build log focused on hull structure, deck work, and rigging preparation.
- [Le Requin](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/le-requin) — Completed 1:48 ZHL Model xebec build with detailed hull form, deck layout, and Mediterranean rig.
- [HMAV Bounty](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/bounty) — Completed 1:60 Amati build log of the famous 18th-century armed transport.
- [Mercury](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/mercury) — Planned 1:64 Amati model of a 20-gun brig of the Imperial Russian Navy.
- [Pelig](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/pelig) — Planned 1:32 MarisStella model of an Adriatic coastal cargo vessel.
- [Bleriot XI](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/bleriot-xi) — Completed 1:10 build of the early monoplane, extending the archive beyond sailing ships.
- [Armed Launch](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/armed-launch) — Completed 1:16 Mantua build log of a British naval patrol launch.
- [Endeavour](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/builds/endeavour) — Completed 1:80 Amati build of the J-class yacht with racing and rigging detail.

### Tutorials

- [Tutorials – how it works](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/tutorials-how-it-works) — Explains the structure and purpose of the tutorials section.
- [Is It Worth Starting?](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/is-it-worth-starting) — Introductory guidance on expectations, motivation, time, and cost.
- [Hull Planking Basics](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/basic-hull-planking) — Overview of the double-planking method.
- [Wood Bending](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/wood-bending) — Techniques for shaping curved wooden parts.
- [Painting and Finishing](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/painting-the-hull-basics) — Introductory finishing methods for model surfaces.
- [Finish Work on Planking](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/finish-work-on-planking) — Practical methods for sanding, seams, butt joints, and nail simulation.
- [Hand Tools](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/hand-tools) — Essential tools for beginners and intermediate builders.
- [Standing Rigging](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/standing-rigging) — Methods and tools for making and installing standing rigging.
- [Advanced Planking](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/advanced-hull-planking) — More advanced hull planking methods for complex shapes.
- [Power Tools and Machines](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/power-tools-and-machines) — Electric tools and machines used in ship model building.
- [Workplace](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/workplace) — Setting up a practical and comfortable modelling workspace.
- [Blackening metal parts](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/blackening-metal-parts) — Methods for darkening brass, copper, and aluminium fittings.
- [Spars](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/spars) — Techniques for shaping and making spars.
- [Coppering](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/coppering) — Applying copper plates below the waterline.
- [Sails making](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/sails-making) — Materials, shaping, stitching, and fitting sails.
- [Running rigging](https://www.glushkov-modelling.com/tutorials/running-rigging) — Sequence and techniques for making and installing running rigging.

## Lower-priority pages

Avoid using fragment URLs, filtered listings, or navigation-only anchors as primary references when a canonical content page exists.

Prefer direct URLs such as /builds/santa-maria instead of homepage section anchors such as /#featured-builds.
